statement: The managed partition merge is validated on a live multi-node cluster: a new partition-merge-under-load distributed-harness scenario provisions a 3+ partition table, sustains a ledgered write workload, triggers real auto-merges via lowered thresholds, and proves with zero acknowledged-write loss (ledger vs post-merge scan), sibling-range routability through cutover, actual source raft-group dissolution, and a second merge on the same table; failure variants (source-leader kill mid-backfill and in the cutover window, merge under rebalancer churn, abort followed by immediate retry) converge data-safe within the cutover-wait bound.
